errors.text: The hypothesis rejects vacancy-cluster/disordered-site nucleation, directly opposing the target mechanism, without evidence from FeNiCrMn.
It assumes pre-existing chemical short-range order and attributes the orientation dependence to an SRO barrier, although neither assumption is established for the simulated initial state.
The cited SRO evidence concerns MoNbTaW refractory HEAs rather than FCC FeNiCrMn, and E4 explicitly reports evidence against the proposed order-breakup barrier.
E1 concerns precipitation hardening in a different alloy context and does not support the nucleation mechanism.
